title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage (Episode 24)
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari explores historical narratives concerning the Prophet Muhammad in Umayyad and Islamic traditions.
